name: email_folder_empty
title: Empty Mail Folder
description: Delete all messages in one mail folder, such as Junk Email or Deleted Items, up to max_messages per call. Subfolders are kept. Requires confirm=true after the user approves. Deleted messages cannot be restored with these tools.

folder_id.description: Mail folder ID, or one of the aliases inbox, sent, drafts, deleted, junk, archive.

account_id.description: Account ID or email address. Omit when only one account is signed in.

max_messages.description: Most messages to delete in this call.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete every message in this folder; set only after the user approves.

summary.description: One-line human summary; also returned as the text content.

validation_rules.error: Invalid confirm 'False': empty folder requires confirm=True to proceed. Expected: Explicit user confirmation

validation_rules.rule: Partial batch failures are reported, not retried blindly.
validation_rules.error: Deleted 180 of 200; 20 failed (see remaining). Call again to retry the rest
